# skycloak_cluster_events_export (Data Source)

Exports a cluster's events as a document (the raw export body).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_events_export" "production" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `document` (String) The exported events document.
